1935, March
FR. SOLANUS, NOTEBOOK NO. 5.
Blank Page
Mar. 19 Mrs. Mary Ulrich - 41 - cancer stomach 11 yrs., no solid food for 4 yrs., 38 days has not been able to retain any, the food or liquid - Holy Communion, however, stays with her if she drinks nothing af- ter. Husband honest lutherin. Mrs. U. weighed 188 1bs. now only 49 lbs. Both enrolled To-night - He decides - promises to be earn- est about religion and find out.
Viola Youngbloon - 33 - heart had serious leakage 10 weeks ago - now thank God.
Dr. Fred Busby - about 45 - "nothing" - cancer of stomach and blood
20 David Cunningham - 35 - Episcopelian - three operations in 4 week - pertinitis. Yesterday given 24 hours to live. Enrolled at 4:15 P.M.
22 Alfred Powelec - 12 - altar boy - doctor doubtful at to cause of dan- gerous abcess in side; to have 3rd blood transfusions Today. Parents have been careless .... Promise frequent Communion . March 24th - 3rd transfusion abandoned as vain. Drs. have no hope .... Parents were to Holy Communion this a.m .... Boy happy & hopeful says he will "serve for Easter" - now has apetite - 27th no apetite but looks better.
Blank Page
Page 320 Page 321 Mar. 22 Mrs. Car. Harley - 69 - bad goiter, dreads operation - Hopes to escape ... get well ... makes her impatient ....
24 Orfa. Boyer - in T.B. Sanitorium - to ... operated on 27th - rib opera- tion 2nd time.
Allier Wylaz - 6 of Oakfield, N.Y. - blind positively since about Dec. Ist last. Father away from confession 5 yrs ... Mother twice a year. She promises to do better and influence him to go back ... Mrs. M. Rabedeau ... see March 1926.
25 Raymond Jackalski - 7 - neck paralysis ... worse just lately ... Mother wants to thank ... asks further prayers ..
Herbert Mitchell - 50 - convert - out of work
Page 318 Page 319
